annotations.title: Other choices for one item of a Trip720 trip

description: For one line of an option in a trip already planned on Trip720 (a stay, a flight, a transfer, an activity), the other choices the providers offer, numbered, each with its price and what it does to the whole trip's Safe Trip Total and budget. Line ids and option ids come from plan_trip or get_trip. Read only; searches the providers again.
name: trip_alternatives
